rule: A control drawn for a login whose cards its own action refuses (backlog #79sqf). scripts/check-control-activity.mjs fails on any finding not listed here and on any entry that is no longer a finding. Each entry is an unfixed fault or a recorded false positive from the check's first run (2026-11-11): FIX it and delete the entry, never treat it as a ruling that it is fine. Never add an entry to make a new control pass: draw the control only when can() asks the activity its action asks. Shrink-only.

entries.found: gated on maintenance.progress:edit; its action asks recurring.do_any:edit, recurring.do_own:edit
entries.reason: READ, FALSE POSITIVE of the check, narrowed 2026-11-11 (claude/control-check-false-positives): takeBack reaches recordRecurringJob only when `occursOn` is set, which is `item.kind === "recurring"`, and the button is drawn under `item.kind === "recurring" || canEditMaintenance`; the maintenance arm (setMaintenanceStatus) is now judged separately and passes on canEditMaintenance. What is left is that the recurring arm's guard is a PREDICATE ON THE ITEM, not a card (a recurring row only reaches Done-today because this login recorded it), which the check cannot relate to the gate. Needs predicate implication, not a new case.
